name: Petroleum Age: Iron & Refining Patch
description: An iron-friendly Petroleum Age patch for a safe-island server with limited resources: crude oil to bitumen to coke cooking and baking, Electric Stove smelting, coal-free sealed barrel conversion, coke-gated castable iron, disabled rift/temporal storm spawns, and a Blackguard powdermaker trait for charcoal and coke blasting powder.
